map.💡 单间面积 = 长 × 宽；套内面积 = 各间之和；建筑面积 = 套内面积 ÷: Room area = length x width; inner area = sum of rooms; floor area = inner area / (1 - shared ratio).
map.公摊率一般住宅 15%-30%，商业 30%-50%，0 表示不计算公摊: Shared ratio: residential 15%-30%, commercial 30%-50%, 0 means no shared area.
map.阳台按半面积计算时，可将其长或宽减半录入: For half-area balconies, halve length or width when entering.
map.层高不足 2.2m 的空间通常不计入建筑面积: Spaces under 2.2m height usually do not count as floor area.
map.装修公司按使用面积报价时，自己量各房间长宽求和，验证报价基数是否含水。: When the contractor quotes by usable area, measure each room yourself and sum to verify the base includes water or not.
map.前，先汇总可用地面面积，判断大家具能否放下。: first tally usable floor area to judge if large furniture fits.
map.出租按面积计价，用净使用面积对账，避免把公摊算进租金基数。: For area-priced rental, reconcile by net usable area, avoiding shared area in the rent base.
map.卧室 4×3=12，客厅 5×4=20，厨 2.5×2=5，卫 2×1.5=3\:
Bedroom 4x3=12, living 5x4=20, kitchen 2.5x2=5, bath 2x1.5=3
Usable total = 12+20+5+3 = 40 m2
map.使用面积是你能踩到的地面净面积；建筑面积是含墙体和公摊的外包面积，通常大 15%: Usable area is the net floor you can step on; floor area is the enveloping area including walls and shared parts, usually 15%-25% larger.
map.套内使用面积一般算到墙面基层（不含抹灰外扩）；本工具按你输入的净尺寸计，需明确口: Inner usable area usually goes to the wall substrate (no plaster expansion); this tool uses your net input; clarify the basis.
map.各地规则不同，部分飘窗、设备平台不计或半计；以当地测绘为准，本工具只算你输入的可: Rules vary; some bay windows/platforms count not at all or half; follow local survey; this tool counts only entered walkable areas.
